verdict.rationale: Sill's own repo documents clipboard flow in both directions. Mac-copied text is ready to paste on the device, and an explicit Paste in Sill action sends the device's clipboard to the Mac. Nothing in the evidence shows a setting to disable clipboard sharing in either direction, so the 'I can turn that off' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: a documented toggle to disable clipboard sync, per-direction control, independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on content types beyond text.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off

citations.quote: text you copy on your Mac is ready to paste on your device, and Paste in Sill sends what you copied on your device to your Mac's clipboard
